title: Website Maintenance and Security
menuDescription: Planned technical care for updates, releases, recovery, and operational risk.
summary: Keep your website maintainable with a clear cadence for updates, changes, and operational checks.

overview.title: Replace reactive maintenance with a visible operating routine.
paragraphs: We help define the updates, checks, ownership, and release practices needed to keep your site in a supportable state.
Coverage is scoped around the platform and business impact, with clear boundaries for planned work and urgent issues.

features.title: Dependency maintenance

features.title: Security hygiene
features.description: Configuration, access, and known vulnerability checks within the agreed system scope.

features.title: Backup and recovery review
features.description: Existing backup coverage and restore procedures checked where the hosting platform supports them.

features.title: Operational monitoring
features.description: Relevant availability and error signals organized around the agreed support needs.

features.title: Controlled changes

features.title: Maintenance reporting

banner.title: Need a clearer plan for keeping your website supportable?
banner.description: We can review the current platform and define a maintenance scope around its real operating needs.

faqs.question: What can a maintenance agreement cover?
faqs.answer: Coverage can include dependency updates, platform checks, small enhancements, release support, and agreed monitoring. The exact responsibilities and response expectations are documented before work begins.

faqs.question: Does maintenance guarantee that a site cannot be compromised?
faqs.answer: No provider can make that guarantee. Maintenance reduces avoidable risk through updates, access hygiene, configuration review, monitoring, and a defined response process.

faqs.question: Do you need to host the website?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. We can work with an existing hosting setup when access, documentation, and platform capabilities are sufficient for the agreed maintenance work.

faqs.question: Can maintenance include new features?
faqs.answer: Small changes may fit within a maintenance scope. Larger features are estimated separately so they receive the design, engineering, and verification time they require.

faqs.question: Can you take over a site built by another team?
faqs.answer: Yes, after an initial review of the codebase, hosting, dependencies, access, and known issues. That review determines whether the system is ready for ongoing support.
